GeneratingUnit

Type: object

A single or set of synchronous machines for converting mechanical power into alternating-current power. For example, individual machines within a set may be defined for scheduling purposes while a single control signal is derived for the set. In this case there would be a GeneratingUnit for each member of the set and an additional GeneratingUnit corresponding to the set.

 No Additional Properties

root HydroGeneratingUnit

HydroGeneratingUnit

Type: object

A generating unit whose prime mover is a hydraulic turbine (e.g., Francis, Pelton, Kaplan).

 No Additional Properties

root HydroGeneratingUnit GeneratingUnit.GenUnitOpSchedule

GenUnitOpSchedule

Type: object

The generating unit's Operator-approved current operating schedule (or plan), typically produced with the aid of unit commitment type analyses. The X-axis represents absolute time. The Y1-axis represents the status (0=off-line and unavailable: 1=available: 2=must run: 3=must run at fixed power value: etc.). The Y2-axis represents the must run fixed power value where required.

 No Additional Properties

root HydroGeneratingUnit GeneratingUnit.GenUnitOpSchedule RegularIntervalSchedule.TimePoints RegularTimePoint

RegularTimePoint

Type: object

Time point for a schedule where the time between the consecutive points is constant.

 No Additional Properties

root HydroGeneratingUnit GeneratingUnit.GenUnitOpSchedule RegularIntervalSchedule.TimePoints RegularTimePoint RegularTimePoint.sequenceNumber

sequenceNumber

Type: integer

The position of the regular time point in the sequence. Note that time points don't have to be sequential, i.e. time points may be omitted. The actual time for a RegularTimePoint is computed by multiplying the associated regular interval schedule's time step with the regular time point sequence number and adding the associated schedules start time. To specify values for the start time, use sequence number 0. The sequence number cannot be negative.

root HydroGeneratingUnit GeneratingUnit.GenUnitOpSchedule RegularIntervalSchedule.TimePoints RegularTimePoint RegularTimePoint.value1

value1

Type: number

The first value at the time. The meaning of the value is defined by the derived type of the associated schedule.

root HydroGeneratingUnit GeneratingUnit.GenUnitOpSchedule RegularIntervalSchedule.TimePoints RegularTimePoint RegularTimePoint.value2

value2

Type: number

The second value at the time. The meaning of the value is defined by the derived type of the associated schedule.

root HydroGeneratingUnit GeneratingUnit.GenUnitOpSchedule IdentifiedObject.aliasName

aliasName

Type: string

The aliasName is free text human readable name of the object alternative to IdentifiedObject.name. It may be non unique and may not correlate to a naming hierarchy.
The attribute aliasName is retained because of backwards compatibility between CIM relases. It is however recommended to replace aliasName with the Name class as aliasName is planned for retirement at a future time.

mRID

Type: string

Master resource identifier issued by a model authority. The mRID is unique within an exchange context. Global uniqueness is easily achieved by using a UUID, as specified in RFC 4122, for the mRID. The use of UUID is strongly recommended.
For CIMXML data files in RDF syntax conforming to IEC 61970-552, the mRID is mapped to rdf:ID or rdf:about attributes that identify CIM object elements.

root HydroGeneratingUnit GeneratingUnit.governorSCD

governorSCD

Type: object or number

Governor Speed Changer Droop. This is the change in generator power output divided by the change in frequency normalized by the nominal power of the generator and the nominal frequency and expressed in percent and negated. A positive value of speed change droop provides additional generator output upon a drop in frequency.

 No Additional Properties

Normally 0 to 100 on a defined base.

root HydroGeneratingUnit GeneratingUnit.normalPF

normalPF

Type: number

Generating unit economic participation factor. The sum of the participation factors across generating units does not have to sum to one. It is used for representing distributed slack participation factor. The attribute shall be a positive value or zero.

root HydroGeneratingUnit GeneratingUnit.penaltyFactor

penaltyFactor

Type: number

Defined as: 1 / ( 1 - Incremental Transmission Loss); with the Incremental Transmission Loss expressed as a plus or minus value. The typical range of penalty factors is (0.9 to 1.1).

root HydroGeneratingUnit Equipment.aggregate

aggregate

Type: boolean

The aggregate flag provides an alternative way of representing an aggregated (equivalent) element. It is applicable in cases when the dedicated classes for equivalent equipment do not have all of the attributes necessary to represent the required level of detail. In case the flag is set to “true” the single instance of equipment represents multiple pieces of equipment that have been modelled together as an aggregate equivalent obtained by a network reduction procedure. Examples would be power transformers or synchronous machines operating in parallel modelled as a single aggregate power transformer or aggregate synchronous machine.
The attribute is not used for EquivalentBranch, EquivalentShunt and EquivalentInjection.

root HydroGeneratingUnit Equipment.networkAnalysisEnabled

networkAnalysisEnabled

Type: boolean

The equipment is enabled to participate in network analysis. If unspecified, the value is assumed to be true.

root HydroGeneratingUnit Equipment.normallyInService

normallyInService

Type: boolean

Specifies the availability of the equipment under normal operating conditions. True means the equipment is available for topology processing, which determines if the equipment is energized or not. False means that the equipment is treated by network applications as if it is not in the model.

root HydroGeneratingUnit IdentifiedObject.mRID

mRID

Type: string

Master resource identifier issued by a model authority. The mRID is unique within an exchange context. Global uniqueness is easily achieved by using a UUID, as specified in RFC 4122, for the mRID. The use of UUID is strongly recommended.
For CIMXML data files in RDF syntax conforming to IEC 61970-552, the mRID is mapped to rdf:ID or rdf:about attributes that identify CIM object elements.

root HydroGeneratingUnit IdentifiedObject.name

name

Type: string

The name is any free human readable and possibly non unique text naming the object.

root HydroGeneratingUnit Equipment.inService

inService

Type: boolean

Specifies the availability of the equipment. True means the equipment is available for topology processing, which determines if the equipment is energized or not. False means that the equipment is treated by network applications as if it is not in the model.

root HydroGeneratingUnit IdentifiedObject.aliasName

aliasName

Type: string

The aliasName is free text human readable name of the object alternative to IdentifiedObject.name. It may be non unique and may not correlate to a naming hierarchy.
The attribute aliasName is retained because of backwards compatibility between CIM relases. It is however recommended to replace aliasName with the Name class as aliasName is planned for retirement at a future time.

genControlMode

  • "GeneratorControlMode.pulse"

genControlSource

  • "GeneratorControlSource.onAGC"
  • "GeneratorControlSource.unavailable"
  • "GeneratorControlSource.offAGC"
  • "GeneratorControlSource.plantControl"

root NuclearGeneratingUnit GeneratingUnit.GenUnitOpSchedule

GenUnitOpSchedule

Type: object

The generating unit's Operator-approved current operating schedule (or plan), typically produced with the aid of unit commitment type analyses. The X-axis represents absolute time. The Y1-axis represents the status (0=off-line and unavailable: 1=available: 2=must run: 3=must run at fixed power value: etc.). The Y2-axis represents the must run fixed power value where required.

Same definition as GeneratingUnit.GenUnitOpSchedule

root NuclearGeneratingUnit GeneratingUnit.governorSCD

governorSCD

Type: object or number

Governor Speed Changer Droop. This is the change in generator power output divided by the change in frequency normalized by the nominal power of the generator and the nominal frequency and expressed in percent and negated. A positive value of speed change droop provides additional generator output upon a drop in frequency.

 No Additional Properties

root HydroGeneratingUnit GeneratingUnit.governorSCD value
Type: number Default: null

Normally 0 to 100 on a defined base.

root NuclearGeneratingUnit GeneratingUnit.nominalP

nominalP

Type: object or number

The nominal power of the generating unit. Used to give precise meaning to percentage based attributes such as the governor speed change droop (governorSCD attribute).
The attribute shall be a positive value equal to or less than RotatingMachine.ratedS.

 No Additional Properties

root NuclearGeneratingUnit GeneratingUnit.normalPF

normalPF

Type: number

Generating unit economic participation factor. The sum of the participation factors across generating units does not have to sum to one. It is used for representing distributed slack participation factor. The attribute shall be a positive value or zero.

root NuclearGeneratingUnit GeneratingUnit.penaltyFactor

penaltyFactor

Type: number

Defined as: 1 / ( 1 - Incremental Transmission Loss); with the Incremental Transmission Loss expressed as a plus or minus value. The typical range of penalty factors is (0.9 to 1.1).

root NuclearGeneratingUnit IdentifiedObject.description

description

Type: string

The description is a free human readable text describing or naming the object. It may be non unique and may not correlate to a naming hierarchy.

root NuclearGeneratingUnit Equipment.aggregate

aggregate

Type: boolean

The aggregate flag provides an alternative way of representing an aggregated (equivalent) element. It is applicable in cases when the dedicated classes for equivalent equipment do not have all of the attributes necessary to represent the required level of detail. In case the flag is set to “true” the single instance of equipment represents multiple pieces of equipment that have been modelled together as an aggregate equivalent obtained by a network reduction procedure. Examples would be power transformers or synchronous machines operating in parallel modelled as a single aggregate power transformer or aggregate synchronous machine.
The attribute is not used for EquivalentBranch, EquivalentShunt and EquivalentInjection.

root NuclearGeneratingUnit Equipment.networkAnalysisEnabled

networkAnalysisEnabled

Type: boolean

The equipment is enabled to participate in network analysis. If unspecified, the value is assumed to be true.

totalEfficiency

root NuclearGeneratingUnit Equipment.normallyInService

normallyInService

Type: boolean

Specifies the availability of the equipment under normal operating conditions. True means the equipment is available for topology processing, which determines if the equipment is energized or not. False means that the equipment is treated by network applications as if it is not in the model.

root NuclearGeneratingUnit IdentifiedObject.mRID

mRID

Type: string

Master resource identifier issued by a model authority. The mRID is unique within an exchange context. Global uniqueness is easily achieved by using a UUID, as specified in RFC 4122, for the mRID. The use of UUID is strongly recommended.
For CIMXML data files in RDF syntax conforming to IEC 61970-552, the mRID is mapped to rdf:ID or rdf:about attributes that identify CIM object elements.

root NuclearGeneratingUnit IdentifiedObject.name

name

Type: string

The name is any free human readable and possibly non unique text naming the object.

root NuclearGeneratingUnit Equipment.inService

inService

Type: boolean

Specifies the availability of the equipment. True means the equipment is available for topology processing, which determines if the equipment is energized or not. False means that the equipment is treated by network applications as if it is not in the model.

root NuclearGeneratingUnit IdentifiedObject.aliasName

aliasName

Type: string

The aliasName is free text human readable name of the object alternative to IdentifiedObject.name. It may be non unique and may not correlate to a naming hierarchy.
The attribute aliasName is retained because of backwards compatibility between CIM relases. It is however recommended to replace aliasName with the Name class as aliasName is planned for retirement at a future time.

root SolarGeneratingUnit GeneratingUnit.GenUnitOpSchedule

GenUnitOpSchedule

Type: object

The generating unit's Operator-approved current operating schedule (or plan), typically produced with the aid of unit commitment type analyses. The X-axis represents absolute time. The Y1-axis represents the status (0=off-line and unavailable: 1=available: 2=must run: 3=must run at fixed power value: etc.). The Y2-axis represents the must run fixed power value where required.

Same definition as GeneratingUnit.GenUnitOpSchedule

root SolarGeneratingUnit GeneratingUnit.governorSCD

governorSCD

Type: object or number

Governor Speed Changer Droop. This is the change in generator power output divided by the change in frequency normalized by the nominal power of the generator and the nominal frequency and expressed in percent and negated. A positive value of speed change droop provides additional generator output upon a drop in frequency.

 No Additional Properties

root SolarGeneratingUnit GeneratingUnit.normalPF

normalPF

Type: number

Generating unit economic participation factor. The sum of the participation factors across generating units does not have to sum to one. It is used for representing distributed slack participation factor. The attribute shall be a positive value or zero.

root SolarGeneratingUnit GeneratingUnit.penaltyFactor

penaltyFactor

Type: number

Defined as: 1 / ( 1 - Incremental Transmission Loss); with the Incremental Transmission Loss expressed as a plus or minus value. The typical range of penalty factors is (0.9 to 1.1).

root SolarGeneratingUnit IdentifiedObject.description

description

Type: string

The description is a free human readable text describing or naming the object. It may be non unique and may not correlate to a naming hierarchy.

root SolarGeneratingUnit Equipment.aggregate

aggregate

Type: boolean

The aggregate flag provides an alternative way of representing an aggregated (equivalent) element. It is applicable in cases when the dedicated classes for equivalent equipment do not have all of the attributes necessary to represent the required level of detail. In case the flag is set to “true” the single instance of equipment represents multiple pieces of equipment that have been modelled together as an aggregate equivalent obtained by a network reduction procedure. Examples would be power transformers or synchronous machines operating in parallel modelled as a single aggregate power transformer or aggregate synchronous machine.
The attribute is not used for EquivalentBranch, EquivalentShunt and EquivalentInjection.

root SolarGeneratingUnit Equipment.networkAnalysisEnabled

networkAnalysisEnabled

Type: boolean

The equipment is enabled to participate in network analysis. If unspecified, the value is assumed to be true.

totalEfficiency

Type: object or number

The efficiency of the unit in converting the fuel into electrical energy.

 No Additional Properties

root SolarGeneratingUnit Equipment.normallyInService

normallyInService

Type: boolean

Specifies the availability of the equipment under normal operating conditions. True means the equipment is available for topology processing, which determines if the equipment is energized or not. False means that the equipment is treated by network applications as if it is not in the model.

root SolarGeneratingUnit IdentifiedObject.mRID

mRID

Type: string

Master resource identifier issued by a model authority. The mRID is unique within an exchange context. Global uniqueness is easily achieved by using a UUID, as specified in RFC 4122, for the mRID. The use of UUID is strongly recommended.
For CIMXML data files in RDF syntax conforming to IEC 61970-552, the mRID is mapped to rdf:ID or rdf:about attributes that identify CIM object elements.

root SolarGeneratingUnit IdentifiedObject.name

name

Type: string

The name is any free human readable and possibly non unique text naming the object.

root SolarGeneratingUnit Equipment.inService

inService

Type: boolean

Specifies the availability of the equipment. True means the equipment is available for topology processing, which determines if the equipment is energized or not. False means that the equipment is treated by network applications as if it is not in the model.

root SolarGeneratingUnit IdentifiedObject.aliasName

aliasName

Type: string

The aliasName is free text human readable name of the object alternative to IdentifiedObject.name. It may be non unique and may not correlate to a naming hierarchy.
The attribute aliasName is retained because of backwards compatibility between CIM relases. It is however recommended to replace aliasName with the Name class as aliasName is planned for retirement at a future time.

  • "GeneratorControlMode.pulse"

genControlSource

root ThermalGeneratingUnit GeneratingUnit.GenUnitOpSchedule

GenUnitOpSchedule

Type: object

The generating unit's Operator-approved current operating schedule (or plan), typically produced with the aid of unit commitment type analyses. The X-axis represents absolute time. The Y1-axis represents the status (0=off-line and unavailable: 1=available: 2=must run: 3=must run at fixed power value: etc.). The Y2-axis represents the must run fixed power value where required.

Same definition as GeneratingUnit.GenUnitOpSchedule

root ThermalGeneratingUnit GeneratingUnit.governorSCD

governorSCD

Type: object or number

Governor Speed Changer Droop. This is the change in generator power output divided by the change in frequency normalized by the nominal power of the generator and the nominal frequency and expressed in percent and negated. A positive value of speed change droop provides additional generator output upon a drop in frequency.

 No Additional Properties

root HydroGeneratingUnit GeneratingUnit.governorSCD value
Type: number Default: null

Normally 0 to 100 on a defined base.

root ThermalGeneratingUnit GeneratingUnit.normalPF

normalPF

Type: number

Generating unit economic participation factor. The sum of the participation factors across generating units does not have to sum to one. It is used for representing distributed slack participation factor. The attribute shall be a positive value or zero.

root ThermalGeneratingUnit GeneratingUnit.penaltyFactor

penaltyFactor

Type: number

Defined as: 1 / ( 1 - Incremental Transmission Loss); with the Incremental Transmission Loss expressed as a plus or minus value. The typical range of penalty factors is (0.9 to 1.1).

root ThermalGeneratingUnit IdentifiedObject.description

description

Type: string

The description is a free human readable text describing or naming the object. It may be non unique and may not correlate to a naming hierarchy.

root ThermalGeneratingUnit Equipment.aggregate

aggregate

Type: boolean

The aggregate flag provides an alternative way of representing an aggregated (equivalent) element. It is applicable in cases when the dedicated classes for equivalent equipment do not have all of the attributes necessary to represent the required level of detail. In case the flag is set to “true” the single instance of equipment represents multiple pieces of equipment that have been modelled together as an aggregate equivalent obtained by a network reduction procedure. Examples would be power transformers or synchronous machines operating in parallel modelled as a single aggregate power transformer or aggregate synchronous machine.
The attribute is not used for EquivalentBranch, EquivalentShunt and EquivalentInjection.

root ThermalGeneratingUnit Equipment.networkAnalysisEnabled

networkAnalysisEnabled

Type: boolean

The equipment is enabled to participate in network analysis. If unspecified, the value is assumed to be true.

root ThermalGeneratingUnit IdentifiedObject.mRID

mRID

Type: string

Master resource identifier issued by a model authority. The mRID is unique within an exchange context. Global uniqueness is easily achieved by using a UUID, as specified in RFC 4122, for the mRID. The use of UUID is strongly recommended.
For CIMXML data files in RDF syntax conforming to IEC 61970-552, the mRID is mapped to rdf:ID or rdf:about attributes that identify CIM object elements.

root ThermalGeneratingUnit IdentifiedObject.aliasName

aliasName

Type: string

The aliasName is free text human readable name of the object alternative to IdentifiedObject.name. It may be non unique and may not correlate to a naming hierarchy.
The attribute aliasName is retained because of backwards compatibility between CIM relases. It is however recommended to replace aliasName with the Name class as aliasName is planned for retirement at a future time.

  • "GeneratorControlSource.unavailable"

root WindGeneratingUnit GeneratingUnit.GenUnitOpSchedule

GenUnitOpSchedule

Type: object

The generating unit's Operator-approved current operating schedule (or plan), typically produced with the aid of unit commitment type analyses. The X-axis represents absolute time. The Y1-axis represents the status (0=off-line and unavailable: 1=available: 2=must run: 3=must run at fixed power value: etc.). The Y2-axis represents the must run fixed power value where required.

root WindGeneratingUnit GeneratingUnit.governorSCD

governorSCD

Type: object or number

Governor Speed Changer Droop. This is the change in generator power output divided by the change in frequency normalized by the nominal power of the generator and the nominal frequency and expressed in percent and negated. A positive value of speed change droop provides additional generator output upon a drop in frequency.

 No Additional Properties

Normally 0 to 100 on a defined base.

root WindGeneratingUnit GeneratingUnit.normalPF

normalPF

Type: number

Generating unit economic participation factor. The sum of the participation factors across generating units does not have to sum to one. It is used for representing distributed slack participation factor. The attribute shall be a positive value or zero.

root WindGeneratingUnit GeneratingUnit.penaltyFactor

penaltyFactor

Type: number

Defined as: 1 / ( 1 - Incremental Transmission Loss); with the Incremental Transmission Loss expressed as a plus or minus value. The typical range of penalty factors is (0.9 to 1.1).

root HydroGeneratingUnit GeneratingUnit.startupCost value
Type: number Default: null

nan

root WindGeneratingUnit IdentifiedObject.description

description

Type: string

The description is a free human readable text describing or naming the object. It may be non unique and may not correlate to a naming hierarchy.

root WindGeneratingUnit Equipment.aggregate

aggregate

Type: boolean

The aggregate flag provides an alternative way of representing an aggregated (equivalent) element. It is applicable in cases when the dedicated classes for equivalent equipment do not have all of the attributes necessary to represent the required level of detail. In case the flag is set to “true” the single instance of equipment represents multiple pieces of equipment that have been modelled together as an aggregate equivalent obtained by a network reduction procedure. Examples would be power transformers or synchronous machines operating in parallel modelled as a single aggregate power transformer or aggregate synchronous machine.
The attribute is not used for EquivalentBranch, EquivalentShunt and EquivalentInjection.

root WindGeneratingUnit Equipment.networkAnalysisEnabled

networkAnalysisEnabled

Type: boolean

The equipment is enabled to participate in network analysis. If unspecified, the value is assumed to be true.

totalEfficiency

The efficiency of the unit in converting the fuel into electrical energy.

root WindGeneratingUnit Equipment.normallyInService

normallyInService

Type: boolean

Specifies the availability of the equipment under normal operating conditions. True means the equipment is available for topology processing, which determines if the equipment is energized or not. False means that the equipment is treated by network applications as if it is not in the model.

root WindGeneratingUnit WindGeneratingUnit.windGenUnitType

windGenUnitType

Type: enum (of string)

The kind of wind generating unit.

Must be one of:

  • "WindGenUnitKind.onshore"
  • "WindGenUnitKind.offshore"

root WindGeneratingUnit IdentifiedObject.mRID

mRID

Type: string

Master resource identifier issued by a model authority. The mRID is unique within an exchange context. Global uniqueness is easily achieved by using a UUID, as specified in RFC 4122, for the mRID. The use of UUID is strongly recommended.
For CIMXML data files in RDF syntax conforming to IEC 61970-552, the mRID is mapped to rdf:ID or rdf:about attributes that identify CIM object elements.

root WindGeneratingUnit IdentifiedObject.name

name

Type: string

The name is any free human readable and possibly non unique text naming the object.

root WindGeneratingUnit Equipment.inService

inService

Type: boolean

Specifies the availability of the equipment. True means the equipment is available for topology processing, which determines if the equipment is energized or not. False means that the equipment is treated by network applications as if it is not in the model.

root WindGeneratingUnit IdentifiedObject.aliasName

aliasName

Type: string

The aliasName is free text human readable name of the object alternative to IdentifiedObject.name. It may be non unique and may not correlate to a naming hierarchy.
The attribute aliasName is retained because of backwards compatibility between CIM relases. It is however recommended to replace aliasName with the Name class as aliasName is planned for retirement at a future time.

root GeneratingUnit.GenUnitOpSchedule

GenUnitOpSchedule

Type: object

The generating unit's Operator-approved current operating schedule (or plan), typically produced with the aid of unit commitment type analyses. The X-axis represents absolute time. The Y1-axis represents the status (0=off-line and unavailable: 1=available: 2=must run: 3=must run at fixed power value: etc.). The Y2-axis represents the must run fixed power value where required.

Same definition as GeneratingUnit.GenUnitOpSchedule

root GeneratingUnit.governorSCD

governorSCD

Type: object or number

Governor Speed Changer Droop. This is the change in generator power output divided by the change in frequency normalized by the nominal power of the generator and the nominal frequency and expressed in percent and negated. A positive value of speed change droop provides additional generator output upon a drop in frequency.

 No Additional Properties

root GeneratingUnit.nominalP

nominalP

Type: object or number

The nominal power of the generating unit. Used to give precise meaning to percentage based attributes such as the governor speed change droop (governorSCD attribute).
The attribute shall be a positive value equal to or less than RotatingMachine.ratedS.

 No Additional Properties

root GeneratingUnit.normalPF

normalPF

Type: number

Generating unit economic participation factor. The sum of the participation factors across generating units does not have to sum to one. It is used for representing distributed slack participation factor. The attribute shall be a positive value or zero.

root GeneratingUnit.penaltyFactor

penaltyFactor

Type: number

Defined as: 1 / ( 1 - Incremental Transmission Loss); with the Incremental Transmission Loss expressed as a plus or minus value. The typical range of penalty factors is (0.9 to 1.1).

root Equipment.aggregate

aggregate

Type: boolean

The aggregate flag provides an alternative way of representing an aggregated (equivalent) element. It is applicable in cases when the dedicated classes for equivalent equipment do not have all of the attributes necessary to represent the required level of detail. In case the flag is set to “true” the single instance of equipment represents multiple pieces of equipment that have been modelled together as an aggregate equivalent obtained by a network reduction procedure. Examples would be power transformers or synchronous machines operating in parallel modelled as a single aggregate power transformer or aggregate synchronous machine.
The attribute is not used for EquivalentBranch, EquivalentShunt and EquivalentInjection.

root Equipment.networkAnalysisEnabled

networkAnalysisEnabled

The equipment is enabled to participate in network analysis. If unspecified, the value is assumed to be true.

root IdentifiedObject.mRID

mRID

Type: string

Master resource identifier issued by a model authority. The mRID is unique within an exchange context. Global uniqueness is easily achieved by using a UUID, as specified in RFC 4122, for the mRID. The use of UUID is strongly recommended.
For CIMXML data files in RDF syntax conforming to IEC 61970-552, the mRID is mapped to rdf:ID or rdf:about attributes that identify CIM object elements.

root IdentifiedObject.aliasName

aliasName

Type: string

The aliasName is free text human readable name of the object alternative to IdentifiedObject.name. It may be non unique and may not correlate to a naming hierarchy.
The attribute aliasName is retained because of backwards compatibility between CIM relases. It is however recommended to replace aliasName with the Name class as aliasName is planned for retirement at a future time.

root GeneratingUnit.genControlSource

genControlSource

The source of controls for a generating unit. Defines the control status of the generating unit.

Must be one of:

  • "GeneratorControlSource.onAGC"
  • "GeneratorControlSource.unavailable"
  • "GeneratorControlSource.offAGC"
  • "GeneratorControlSource.plantControl"
